name_zh: 中國醫療器材品質管理法規

4.1.rationale_en: The text states that enterprises “shall establish and improve a quality management system suitable for the medical devices they produce, and ensure its effective operation.” This directly aligns with ISO 13485:2016 clause 4.1.
4.1.rationale_zh: 文本指出，企业“应建立健全与其生产的医疗器械相适应的质量管理体系，并保证其有效运行。”这与ISO 13485:2016 第4.1条款直接一致。
4.1.original_text: 企业应当按照本规范的要求，结合产品特点，建立健全与所生产医疗器械相适应的质量管理体系，并保证其有效运行。
4.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall, in accordance with the requirements of this specification, combine product characteristics to establish and improve a quality management system suitable for the medical devices they produce, and ensure its effective operation.
4.1.semantic_note: Refers to establishing and maintaining a QMS.

5.3.rationale_en: The text states that companies must establish quality objectives and ensure they are understood and effectively achieved throughout the QMS, aligning with the intent of ISO 13485:2016 clause 5.3 regarding quality policy.
5.3.rationale_zh: 文本指出，企业必须建立质量目标并确保其在整个质量管理体系中得到理解和有效实现，这与ISO 13485:2016 第5.3 条关于质量政策的要求一致。
5.3.original_text: 企业应当履行医疗器械质量安全主体责任，建立符合医疗器械质量管理要求的质量目标，将医疗器械产品安全、有效和质量可控的所有要求，系统地贯彻到质量管理体系运行全过程，确保质量目标被充分理解和有效实现。
5.3.english_translation: Enterprises shall perform the responsibility for medical device quality and safety, establish quality objectives that meet the requirements of medical device quality management, systematically implement all requirements for medical device products to be safe, effective, and controllable into the entire process of operation of the quality management system, and ensure that quality objectives are fully understood and effectively achieved.
5.3.semantic_note: Focuses on establishing and achieving quality objectives as a core responsibility.

5.4.1.rationale_en: The text mentions establishing quality objectives, which aligns with the intent of ISO 13485:2016 clause 5.4.1 regarding documented information to support quality objectives.
5.4.1.rationale_zh: 文本提到了建立质量目标，这与ISO 13485:2016 第5.4.1 条关于支持质量目标的记录信息的要求一致。
5.4.1.original_text: 企业应当履行医疗器械质量安全主体责任，建立符合医疗器械质量管理要求的质量目标，将医疗器械产品安全、有效和质量可控的所有要求，系统地贯彻到质量管理体系运行全过程，确保质量目标被充分理解和有效实现。
5.4.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall perform the responsibility for medical device quality and safety, establish quality objectives that meet the requirements of medical device quality management, systematically implement all requirements for medical device products to be safe, effective, and controllable into the entire process of operation of the quality management system, and ensure that quality objectives are fully understood and effectively achieved.
5.4.1.semantic_note: Implies documentation related to quality objectives.

5.4.2.rationale_en: The provided text does not explicitly address the planning of the quality management system.

5.5.1.rationale_en: The text states that personnel should participate in activities to achieve quality objectives and bear corresponding responsibilities, aligning with the intent of ISO 13485:2016 clause 5.5.1 regarding responsibility and authority.
5.5.1.rationale_zh: 文本指出，人员应参与活动以实现质量目标并承担相应责任，这与ISO 13485:2016 第5.5.1 条关于责任和权限的要求一致。
5.5.1.original_text: 企业各级人员应当共同参与实现质量目标的各项活动并承担相应责任。
5.5.1.english_translation: Personnel at all levels of the enterprise should jointly participate in various activities to achieve quality objectives and assume corresponding responsibilities.
5.5.1.semantic_note: Highlights responsibility for achieving quality objectives.

5.6.3.rationale_en: The text mentions 'management review' as a method for continuous improvement of the quality management system, processes, and product quality.
5.6.3.rationale_zh: 文本提到“管理评审”是质量管理体系、工艺和产品质量持续改进的方法。
5.6.3.original_text: 企业应当通过…内部审核以及管理评审等方式，实现质量管理体系、工艺和产品质量的持续改进。
5.6.3.english_translation: Enterprises shall, through... internal audits and management reviews, achieve continuous improvement of the quality management system, processes, and product quality.
5.6.3.semantic_note: Management review is mentioned as part of a broader set of activities for continuous improvement.

6.1.rationale_en: The text states that enterprises must provide sufficient personnel, facilities, and equipment to achieve quality objectives.
6.1.rationale_zh: 文本指出，企业必须提供足够的人员、厂房设施和设备来实现质量目标。
6.1.original_text: 企业应当为实现质量目标配备足够并符合要求的人员、厂房设施和设备等资源。
6.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall provide sufficient personnel, facilities and equipment that meet the requirements to achieve quality objectives.

6.2.english_translation: Personnel at all levels of the enterprise shall participate in various activities to achieve quality objectives and assume corresponding responsibilities.
6.2.semantic_note: Addresses personnel involvement, but not explicitly training or competency.

7.1.rationale_en: The text requires a change control procedure to assess the risk of changes on safety, effectiveness and quality controllability.
7.1.rationale_zh: 文本要求建立变更控制程序，以评估变更对安全、有效性和质量可控性的风险。
7.1.original_text: 企业应当建立变更控制程序，根据变更对医疗器械安全性、有效性和质量可控性影响的风险程度和相关法规要求，确定变更管理类型，对变更进行评审，在实施前得到相应批准。
7.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall establish a change control procedure, according to the risk level of changes on the safety, effectiveness and quality controllability of medical devices and relevant regulatory requirements, determine the type of change management, review the changes, and obtain corresponding approval before implementation.
7.1.semantic_note: Addresses planning for product realization through change control.

7.2.1.rationale_en: The text explicitly states that raw materials used must be correct and error-free, aligning with the requirement to determine requirements related to products.
7.2.1.rationale_zh: 文本明确指出使用的原材料必须正确无误，符合确定与产品相关要求。
7.2.1.original_text: 企业应当建立质量保证系统…确保：(三) 采购和使用的原材料正确无误；
7.2.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall establish a quality assurance system... ensuring: (iii) Raw materials purchased and used are correct and error-free;
7.2.1.semantic_note: Addresses determination of product requirements, specifically regarding raw materials.

7.2.2.rationale_en: Article 3 states that enterprises should establish and maintain a quality management system suitable for the medical devices they produce. Article 7 requires companies to fulfill their responsibilities regarding product safety and effectiveness and systematically implement all requirements into the QMS. Article 9(1) specifies that design, production management, and quality control activities must comply with this regulation.
7.2.2.rationale_zh: 第三条规定企业应建立健全与所生产医疗器械相适应的质量管理体系。第七条要求公司履行产品安全、有效的责任，并将所有要求系统地贯彻到质量管理体系运行全过程。第九条(1)规定设计开发、生产管理和质量控制活动必须符合本规范。
7.2.2.original_text:
第三条 企业应当按照本规范的要求，结合产品特点，建立健全与所生产医疗器械相适应的质量管理体系，并保证其有效运行。
第七条 企业应当履行医疗器械质量安全主体责任，建立符合医疗器械质量管理要求的质量目标，将医疗器械产品安全、有效和质量可控的所有要求，系统地贯彻到质量管理体系运行全过程，确保质量目标被充分理解和有效实现。
第九条（一） 医疗器械的设计开发、生产管理和质量控制活动符合本规范；
7.2.2.semantic_note: Focuses on establishing and maintaining a suitable QMS.

7.2.3.rationale_en: No specific mention of communication requirements related to product information, feedback, or complaints.
7.2.3.rationale_zh: 没有提及与产品信息、反馈或投诉相关的沟通要求。
7.2.3.semantic_note: Communication requirements are not addressed in the provided text.

7.3.1.rationale_en: Article 3 requires establishing a quality management system suitable for the medical devices produced. Article 9(9) states that activities such as commissioned R&D, commissioned production, outsourced processing, and commissioned inspection must be in a controlled state.
7.3.1.rationale_zh: 第三条规定企业应建立健全与所生产医疗器械相适应的质量管理体系。第九条(9)规定委托研发、委托生产、外协加工和委托检验等活动处于受控状态。
7.3.1.original_text:
第三条 企业应当按照本规范的要求，结合产品特点，建立健全与所生产医疗器械相适应的质量管理体系，并保证其有效运行。
第九条（九）委托研发、委托生产、外协加工和委托检验等活动处于受控状态。
7.3.1.semantic_note: Highlights the need for planning and control of design and development activities.

7.3.2.rationale_en: No specific mention of design and development inputs.

7.3.4.rationale_en: Article 10 outlines a change control procedure, requiring review and approval of changes based on risk assessment and regulatory requirements. Validation or verification may be required.
7.3.4.rationale_zh: 第十条规定了变更控制程序，要求根据风险评估和法规要求审查和批准变更。必要时，可能需要验证或确认。
7.3.4.original_text: 第十条 企业应当建立变更控制程序，根据变更对医疗器械安全性、有效性和质量可控性影响的风险程度和相关法规要求，确定变更管理类型，对变更进行评审，在实施前得到相应批准。必要时，应当对变更进行验证、确认，确保不因变更对产品的安全性、有效性和质量可控性产生不良影响。

7.3.5.rationale_en: No specific mention of design and development verification.
7.3.5.rationale_zh: 没有提及设计开发验证。
7.3.5.semantic_note: Design and development verification requirements are not addressed in the provided text.

7.3.6.rationale_en: No specific mention of design and development validation.

7.3.6.semantic_note: Design and development validation requirements are not addressed in the provided text.

7.3.7.rationale_en: The text mentions 'design and development' (设计开发) within the scope of quality management system requirements, but doesn’t explicitly detail transfer activities as defined in ISO 13485:2016. It focuses on overall adherence to regulations during design and development.
7.3.7.rationale_zh: 文本提到了“设计开发”，在质量管理体系的要求范围内，但没有明确详细说明ISO 13485:2016中定义的设计与开发转移活动。它侧重于设计和开发过程中的整体遵守法规。
7.3.7.original_text: 企业应当将风险管理理念贯穿于质量管理体系运行全过程，所采取的控制措施应当与产品存在的风险相适应。
7.3.7.english_translation: Enterprises shall integrate the risk management concept into the entire process of quality management system operation, and the control measures taken should be adapted to the risks existing in the products.
7.3.7.semantic_note: Refers to design and development as part of overall QMS scope.

7.3.8.rationale_en: The text explicitly states the need for a 'change control procedure' (变更控制程序) and outlines requirements for assessing changes based on risk and regulatory needs, and ensuring no adverse impact on safety, efficacy, or quality. This aligns with ISO 13485:2016 clause 7.3.8.
7.3.8.rationale_zh: 文本明确指出需要“变更控制程序”，并概述了根据风险和法规需求评估变更的要求，以及确保对安全、有效性和质量可控性没有不良影响。这与ISO 13485:2016 第7.3.8条款一致。
7.3.8.original_text: 企业应当建立变更控制程序，根据变更对医疗器械安全性、有效性和质量可控性影响的风险程度和相关法规要求，确定变更管理类型，对变更进行评审，在实施前得到相应批准。必要时，应当对变更进行验证、确认，确保不因变更对产品的安全性、有效性和质量可控性产生不良影响。
7.3.8.english_translation: Enterprises shall establish a change control procedure, determine the type of change management according to the risk level of the impact of changes on the safety, efficacy and controllability of medical devices and relevant regulatory requirements, review the changes, and obtain corresponding approval before implementation. When necessary, verification and confirmation should be carried out to ensure that changes do not have an adverse impact on the safety, efficacy and quality control of products.

7.3.9.rationale_en: The text requires the establishment of a 'complete quality management system file' (完整的质量管理体系文件), which implies design and development records are part of it, but doesn’t detail specific requirements for design and development files as outlined in ISO 13485:2016.
7.3.9.rationale_zh: 文本要求建立“完整的质量管理体系文件”，这暗示设计和开发记录是其中的一部分，但没有详细说明ISO 13485:2016中概述的设计和开发文件具体要求。
7.3.9.original_text: 企业应当建立质量保证系统并有完整的质量管理体系文件，保证质量管理体系有效运行。
7.3.9.english_translation: Enterprises shall establish a quality assurance system and have complete quality management system documents to ensure the effective operation of the quality management system.
7.3.9.semantic_note: Refers to overall QMS documentation, not specifically design files.

7.3.10.rationale_en: There is no direct mention of design and development documentation in the provided text.

7.4.1.original_text: 企业应当建立质量保证系统并有完整的质量管理体系文件，保证质量管理体系有效运行。质量保证系统应当确保...（三）采购和使用的原材料正确无误；
7.4.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall establish a quality assurance system and have complete quality management system documents to ensure the effective operation of the quality management system. The quality assurance system should ensure...(iii) Raw materials purchased and used are correct and error-free;

7.5.1.rationale_en: The text requires product release after review and approval (每批（台）产品经审核批准后放行), which aligns with the intent of controlled production, but doesn't cover all aspects of ISO 13485:2016 clause 7.5.1.
7.5.1.rationale_zh: 文本要求在审查和批准后发布产品（每批（台）产品经审核批准后放行），这符合受控生产的意图，但没有涵盖ISO 13485:2016 第7.5.1条款的所有方面。
7.5.1.original_text: 企业应当建立质量保证系统并有完整的质量管理体系文件，保证质量管理体系有效运行。质量保证系统应当确保...（七）严格按照规程进行生产和检验；每批（台）产品经审核批准后放行；
7.5.1.english_translation: Enterprises shall establish a quality assurance system and have complete quality management system documents to ensure the effective operation of the quality management system. The quality assurance system should ensure...(vii) Production and inspection are carried out in strict accordance with procedures; each batch (unit) of products shall be released after review and approval;
7.5.1.semantic_note: Focuses on product release, not all aspects of production control.

7.5.2.rationale_en: The regulation states that measures should be in place to guarantee product quality during storage, transportation, and installation.
7.5.2.rationale_zh: 该法规指出，应采取措施来保证存储、运输和安装过程中的产品质量。
7.5.2.original_text: (八）贮存、运输以及安装等环节有保证产品质量的措施；
7.5.2.english_translation: (VIII) Measures to ensure product quality during storage, transportation and installation;
7.5.2.semantic_note: Addresses cleanliness indirectly through ensuring quality throughout the lifecycle.

7.5.3.rationale_en: The regulation mentions 'installation' as a stage where product quality needs to be ensured.
7.5.3.rationale_zh: 该法规提到了“安装”作为需要保证产品质量的一个阶段。
7.5.3.original_text: (八）贮存、运输以及安装等环节有保证产品质量的措施；
7.5.3.english_translation: (VIII) Measures to ensure product quality during storage, transportation and installation;

7.5.6.rationale_en: The regulation mentions quality data monitoring, change management, and corrective/preventive actions as ways to improve the quality management system.
7.5.6.rationale_zh: 该法规提到了质量数据监控、变更管理和纠正预防措施作为改进质量管理体系的方式。
7.5.6.original_text: 企业应当通过质量数据监控、变更管理、不良事件监测、质量风险管理回顾、纠正预防措施、内部审核以及管理评审等方式，实现质量管理体系、工艺和产品质量的持续改进。
7.5.6.english_translation: Enterprises shall, through quality data monitoring, change management, adverse event monitoring, quality risk management review, corrective and preventive actions, internal audits and management reviews, achieve continuous improvement of the quality management system, process and product quality.

7.5.7.rationale_en: No specific mention of sterilization or sterile barrier systems.

unique_requirements.title_zh: 鼓励企业推进数智化转型
unique_requirements.requirement_en: Enterprises are encouraged to promote digital transformation, improve production and quality management efficiency, and facilitate high-quality industrial development.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 鼓励企业推进数智化转型，提高生产和质量管理效能，促进产业高质量发展。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: Does the company have a strategy or plan for digital transformation related to production and quality management?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 公司是否有与生产和质量管理相关的数字化转型战略或计划？
unique_requirements.rationale_en: This is a national policy direction encouraging modernization, not directly related to ISO 13485 requirements.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: 这是鼓励现代化的国家政策方向，与ISO 13485的要求没有直接关系。
unique_requirements.original_text: 第六条  鼓励企业推进数智化转型，提高生产和质量管理效能，促进产业高质量发展。
unique_requirements.semantic_note: While not mandatory, demonstrating efforts in digital transformation may be viewed favorably by regulators.

unique_requirements.title_en: Separation of Production and Quality Management Responsibilities
unique_requirements.title_zh: 生产管理部门和质量管理部门负责人不得互相兼任
unique_requirements.requirement_en: The heads of the production management department and the quality management department shall not concurrently hold positions.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 企业应当建立与医疗器械生产相适应的组织机构，明确各部门的职责和权限，明确质量管理职能。生产管理部门和质量管理部门负责人不得互相兼任。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: Are the heads of production and quality management departments separate individuals?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 生产和质量管理部门的负责人是分开的人员吗？
unique_requirements.rationale_en: ISO 13485 requires defined responsibilities, but this regulation explicitly prohibits concurrent roles for production and quality heads.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: ISO 13485要求明确的职责，但本法规明确禁止生产和质量负责人同时担任职务。
unique_requirements.original_text: 第十四条  企业应当建立与医疗器械生产相适应的组织机构，明确各部门的职责和权限，明确质量管理职能。生产管理部门和质量管理部门负责人不得互相兼任。
unique_requirements.semantic_note: This strengthens the independence of quality management.
unique_requirements.within_clause_delta_vs_iso: ISO says define responsibilities; China says production and quality heads must be separate.

unique_requirements.title_en: Quality Management Department Authority - Veto Power
unique_requirements.title_zh: 质量管理部门应当独立履行质量保证和质量控制职责，并对产品质量有否决权。
unique_requirements.requirement_en: The quality management department shall independently perform quality assurance and quality control responsibilities, and have the right to veto product quality.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 质量管理部门应当独立履行质量保证和质量控制职责，并对产品质量有否决权。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: Does the quality management department have the authority to reject product release based on quality concerns?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 质量管理部门是否有权根据质量问题拒绝产品发布？
unique_requirements.rationale_en: ISO 13485 emphasizes independence, but this regulation explicitly grants veto power to the quality department.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: ISO 13485强调独立性，但本法规明确授予质量部门否决权。
unique_requirements.original_text: 第十五条  企业应当设立与所生产产品相适应的质量管理部门。质量管理部门应当独立履行质量保证和质量控制职责，并对产品质量有否决权。
unique_requirements.semantic_note: This is a significant strengthening of quality management authority.
unique_requirements.within_clause_delta_vs_iso: ISO says ensure independence; China says the QM department has veto power.
